summary: Expanded the AI networking/optical interconnect node toward scarce suppliers and second-order chokepoints rather than obvious switch/GPU leaders. The most relevant underfollowed pockets in this pass are optical lasers and transceivers, analog optical signal-integrity components, outsourced optical manufacturing/advanced packaging, and 800G/1.6T test-and-validation equipment.
